## Problem and behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for the user or contributor.
Link the related issue; use closing keywords only when all its acceptance is met.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their outcomes. Include relevant CI/commit links.
For native/real-agent evidence, record app/CLI/adapter/OS versions and distinguish
fixture coverage from real-account behavior. For docs, verify links and commands.

## Remaining work or limitations

State skipped checks, environment blockers and any migration or trust changes.
Do not describe pending CI, unperformed native acceptance or blocked vendor
requests as passed. Remove private paths, tokens and session IDs before posting.
